assessment_objectives.objective: a formal, documented capacity and performance planning policy is approved by executive management, or a formally delegated authority, and conveys executive management's intent for capacity and performance planning.

the capacity and performance planning policy provides organizational direction and states the behaviors expected of personnel and other applicable parties with respect to capacity and performance planning.
the current version of the capacity and performance planning policy is communicated to, and accessible by, the personnel and other applicable parties who are expected to comply with it.
the capacity and performance planning policy is reviewed at least annually.

the capacity and performance planning policy is updated, as necessary, in response to changes in risks, threats, business practices and/or statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations that affect the organization.
